reply:
Spikes now hurt the player. The game builds, all the checks and tests pass, and I updated the saved test run so finished games can still be checked and accepted on the leaderboard. "Kill" could also mean the game ends right away on the first touch. I went with the usual platformer meaning instead: you lose one of your lives.

READBACK: When the player touches a spike, they lose one of their 3 lives, hear the hit sound, and go back to the start of the level, standing still. When the last life is lost, the lose sound plays and the game ends. I assumed "kill" means losing one life rather than ending the game straight away. The player can't jump yet, so walking right will always run into the spike in the middle of the floor.
